title: Bottega Coffee Case Study | Shopify eCommerce by 23 Digital

facts.fact: Bottega Coffee's case study lists a campaign budget of $25K.
Bottega Coffee's case study lists a campaign length of 12+ months.
According to 23 Digital, Bottega Coffee's Shopify store saw a 3.8x increase in monthly online sales within 6 months of launch.
facts.quote: Revenue Growth:** 3.8x increase in monthly online sales within 6 months

facts.fact: According to 23 Digital, 44% of Bottega Coffee's monthly orders came from subscribers.
facts.quote: Subscription Revenue:** 44% of monthly orders now from subscribers

facts.fact: According to 23 Digital, Bottega Coffee saw a 49% increase in mobile and tablet conversions.
facts.quote: Conversion Rate:** 49% increase in mobile and tablet conversions

facts.fact: According to 23 Digital, Bottega Coffee saw a 32% increase in repeat purchase rate.
facts.quote: Customer Retention:** 32% increase in repeat purchase rate due to smarter customer flows

facts.fact: The Bottega Coffee project involved 5 resources.
The Bottega Coffee case study lists its target demographic as coffee enthusiasts, café owners, and home brewers.
facts.quote:

Coffee enthusiasts, café owners, home brewers
